title: Sometimes We 'Spread Ourself Too Thin' (2/2)
titleZh: 有時候我們會「分身乏術」(2/2)
summaryZh: 透過兩位老師的對話，示範「事情攬太多、分身乏術」相關的英文說法。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Words and Their Stories

sentences.text: Now, let's hear some of these terms and expressions used in a conversation.
sentences.zh: 現在我們來聽聽這些用語和說法在對話中怎麼使用。

sentences.text: So, how are your classes going?
Many of my best students are failing my course.
sentences.zh: 我班上很多最優秀的學生都快被當了。

sentences.text: They all missed an important deadline for a project.
sentences.zh: 他們都錯過了一份報告的重要繳交期限。

sentences.text: What else do they have going on?
They are all performing in the same play.
sentences.zh: 他們都在同一齣戲裡演出。

sentences.text: So, they have had rehearsals every night for the past month.
sentences.zh: 所以這一個月來，他們每天晚上都在排練。

sentences.text: And many have part-time jobs as well.
sentences.zh: 而且很多人還有兼職工作。

sentences.text: Sounds like they've spread themselves too thin.
sentences.zh: 聽起來他們是事情攬太多、分身乏術了。

sentences.text: They've got too much going on.
sentences.zh: 他們手上的事情實在太多了。

sentences.text: So, what are you going to do?
Well, first I'll extend the deadline.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我會先把繳交期限延後。

sentences.text: And then I'm going to warn them about biting off more than they can chew.
sentences.zh: 然後我要提醒他們，不要什麼都想做、超出自己能負荷的範圍。

sentences.text: And that's all the time we have for this Words and Their Stories.
sentences.zh: 本集的〈Words and Their Stories〉時間就到這裡。

sentences.text: Until next time, I'm Ana Mateo.
